The Danube (German Donau) is the second longest river in Europe. Its native name differs from country to country, and it rises at an elevation of 1078 m in the hills.

A layout cell keeps its text, as old pages put their whole content into tables like this one.

Navigation [edit]

Ships have carried goods on the river for centuries, and many travelers enjoy the slow pace of a cruise between its cities.
